crossRefs.note: For your name’s sake, Yahweh, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.
For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name’s sake lead me and guide me.
But I am in pain and distress. Let your salvation, God, protect me.
Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name. Deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name’s sake.
Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Let it be known among the nations, before our eyes, that vengeance…
Revive me, Yahweh, for your name’s sake. In your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.
In your loving kindness, cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul, For I am your servant.
Jesus said these things, then lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, “Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son…
And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.
How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.
Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.
For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.
But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.

translations.web: But deal with me, Yahweh the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;
translations.bsb: But You, O GOD, the Lord, deal kindly with me for the sake of Your name; deliver me by the goodness of Your loving devotion.
translations.kjv: But do thou for me, O GOD the Lord, for thy name's sake: because thy mercy is good, deliver
translations.asv: But deal thou with me, O Jehovah the Lord, for thy name's sake: Because thy lovingkindness is good, deliver thou me;
